paper_title: Search for oscillations of fundamental constants using molecular spectroscopy
suggested_experiment_name: I2 molecular spectroscopy (Expt A + B, earth halo)
coupling_convention: Q_N·d (Q_hat_N dot d), dimensionless linear combination of scalar QCD-sector couplings, plotted exactly as on the y-axis
notes: Paper sets bounds on oscillating UDM coupling to quarks and gluons (QCD sector), the combination Q_N·d = 0.999 d_gs + 0.092 d_mhat + 3e-4 d_dm + 0.047 d_ms, over 10 Hz–100 MHz (masses ~4e-14 to 4e-7 eV) using I2 molecular spectroscopy (Expts A and B). This is the first bound on gluon/quark couplings; paper also constrains d_alpha (ScalarPhoton, Fig.4a) and d_me (ScalarElectron, Fig.4b). Chose ScalarBaryon per hint, but the QCD-sector coupling is arguably ScalarNucleon (nucleon-mass); coupling type is ambiguous hence low confidence. No numerical tables given; data points are rough reads off Fig. 3 (galactic halo, 95% CL) and are approximate. Coupling values are large dimensionless d_i (~1e4-1e7).
